Thirty-second daf of the Rashi content-quality reconstruction campaign (60 raw lines, 21 legal ids). Continuing the freshly-confirmed queue after 67a and 69a (69b, 70b, 71a all confirmed zero-link rashi-reconstruction targets; 67b needed no work).

The prior content for lines 37-60 was not merely fabricated but genuinely cross-contaminated from neighboring daf: the old vilnaLine-37-through-55 entries described the Yom Kippur bull/goat-burning order dispute (matching 70b's actual subject matter almost verbatim), and vilnaLine 56-60 were a byte-for-byte duplicate of 71a's own 'HP found in the marketplace / He sustains the living / they took leave of each other' passage (confirmed by direct comparison against 71a's file, read earlier this session). None of that content bore any relationship to 69b's own raw Hebrew for those lines, which is actually the continuation of the Men of the Great Assembly aggada (Jeremiah/Daniel each omitting a word from Moses's formula, and why) followed by the Gemara's own discussion of skip-reading rules between Torah portions during the HP's Yom Kippur Torah reading.

Built a definitive line-by-line skeleton for all 60 vilna lines before writing any English, re-extracting the raw Hebrew fresh from the packet. Content covers: the rule that only Davidic kings may sit in the Azarah, and where Rav Chisda's qualifying statement (that this applies specifically in the Women's Courtyard) was actually said, tied to the Ezra assembly narrative and the origin of the 'from world to world' blessing formula, cited to Ta'anit 13a (l01, l04, l08, l12, vilna 1-4); the Men of the Great Assembly's prayer to have the idolatry-inclination handed over, the fiery-lion-cub image, the heavenly note reading 'truth,' and Zechariah's role (l16, l19, l20, l21, vilna 4-9); the inclination's capture and its cry heard 400 parasangs away, silenced by sealing it in a lead cauldron since lead absorbs sound (l24, vilna 9-14); the parallel prayer regarding the sexual-sin inclination, the search for a same-day egg that came up empty (proving the inclination's total suppression halted natural heat/fertility), and its eventual only-partial removal by blinding rather than killing it (l29, vilna 14-22); Rav Matna's formula 'the great, mighty, and awesome God' and Rashi's definition of 'awesome' as impartial justice (l33, vilna 22-23); Jeremiah's and Daniel's respective omissions of 'awesome' and 'mighty' from Moses's formula, each justified by the specific national trauma they witnessed, with the full verse citations to Jeremiah 32 and Daniel 9 (l35, vilna 24-33); the Men of the Great Assembly's restoration of the full formula, reinterpreting God's 'might' as self-restraint and His 'awesomeness' as Israel's improbable survival (l39, vilna 33-40); Rabbi Elazar's answer for why the Rabbis were not considered liars for doing so (l42, vilna 40-42); and the extended sugya on skip-reading during the Yom Kippur Torah reading, resolving an apparent contradiction between beraitot about skipping in the Prophets versus the Torah by distinguishing same-topic skips (permitted within translator-pause time) from cross-topic skips (never permitted, since Torah content must land undivided in the listener's heart) (l43, l44, l47, l48, vilna 42-60).

Sixteen raw lines are genuine dibbur-boundary straddles, including one true triple (vilna line 2, which bridges the Azarah-kings comment, the citation cross-reference to Rav Chisda's own statement, and the opening of the Ezra-blessing lemma, all within one continuous sentence). Audit_rashi_association.py's multi_link count (16, of which 1 is the triple) was checked against this prediction before proceeding; declared_associations=77=44*1+15*2+1*3, matching exactly.

The daf's final raw line (60, the two words 'misof,' 'from the end') is a genuine deferred dibbur hamatchil, continuing Rashi's comment on the beraita's closing clause about skipping among the Twelve Minor Prophets 'from the end' of one to the start of another; boundary policy assigns it to l48, the last id in this packet, with the note flagging (as with 69a's own deferred final line) that the continuation on 70a was not independently verified against an already-built neighbor.

Unlike 69a, this daf's raw Rashi contains four genuine citations, all of which now land at offset 0 after the rebuild (Deuteronomy 18, Ta'anit 13a, Jeremiah 32, Daniel 9), an improvement over the corrupted content's 2-found/2-missing state. Classification is ALIGNED, the strongest evidence tier, so no anchor-attestation block is required.
